name: merch-table
description: A band's own merch store: static pages on your own domain, a cart, Stripe Checkout, free hosting. No platform, no rent, no tracking.

ADMIN_KEY.description: A password for your store's admin. Make up something long and keep it. You type it once per phone or laptop to sign in at `/admin`; everything else is set up there.

STOCK.description: Where your products, orders and settings are kept. Created for you; nothing to do.
